beats.note: MID-ACTION: rope already snapped taut, Moon yanking away, Earth squashed and dragged. Hard push-in.
Earth digs in and strains. Moon pulls again, gains a notch.
Pull back: the gap is visibly bigger. Earth angry, Moon smug.
Earth's spin drags slower; day stretches. Earth straining.
beats.label: LONGER DAYS

beats.note: Sun slides in. Moon still just covers it: total eclipse. Earth happy.
beats.label: TOTAL ECLIPSE

beats.note: Moon now too small. Ring of fire breaks out around it. Earth scared.
CLIMAX + PAYOFF: ring of fire blazes, flash, then wide shot — tiny Moon far away, Earth alone. Loops to b1.
